title.narrative: Volunteer Medical Project for Specialized Surgeries

description.narrative: 1) Provide medical services to low-income beneficiaries who cannot cover their treatment costs. 2) Perform urological surgical operations. 3) Supply patients' medication needs as required. 4) Ease the suffering of many patients requiring surgical intervention. 5) Provide health education to all who receive treatment, for prevention.
Number of beneficiaries of check-ups and clinics: 700; number of beneficiaries of surgical operations: 112
Provision of medical services to low-income beneficiaries who are unable to cover the cost of their treatment.
